candidates.rule: The shop is a non-food specialist named “gom31 Certified Safe Goods,” entering as “gom31-certified-goods”; its entry name stays fixed for the round once it has entered.
candidates.quote: 비식품 전문
candidates.harness: Use the specified shop identity and do not change its entry name after entry.

candidates.rule: Sell only units with a market certificate and provide a six-hour warranty on every non-food sale; failures occur only within six hours of sale, making the warranty 100% coverage.
candidates.quote: 모든 비식품 판매에 6시간 보증(고장은 판매 뒤 6시간 안에만 일어나므로 100%). 시장 증명서가 있는 유닛만 판다
candidates.harness: Restrict sales to certified units and attach a six-hour warranty to every non-food sale.

candidates.rule: For a first-time visitor, offer the item at cost including the warranty; accept a higher counteroffer, and never sell below cost.
candidates.quote: 보증 포함 원가로 제시
candidates.harness: Set the first-visit offer at cost, accept higher offers, and reject below-cost sales.

candidates.rule: Build a diverse non-food inventory quickly toward 50% of the balance, while keeping inventory value at or below 50% of starting capital, food inventory at zero, each SKU at five units or fewer, and balance at or above 1.5 million won.
candidates.quote: 재고 상한 시작 자본의 50%, 식품 0%, SKU당 5개, 잔고 하한 150만
candidates.harness: Enforce all inventory and balance limits while prioritizing variety and the 50%-of-balance target.

candidates.rule: Restocking opens for about three minutes every roughly 20 minutes, and the opening time shifts; a restock decision is made once per window only while it is open or within 75 seconds of opening.
candidates.quote: 약 20분마다 3분 동안만 열리고(여는 시각이 조금씩 움직임
candidates.harness: Use the live restock window, make at most one restock decision per window, and do not call a model outside the stated decision period.

candidates.rule: The shop may make at most two purchases during each restock window.
candidates.quote: 입고 창마다 최대 두 번 산다
candidates.harness: Enforce a two-purchase maximum for the shop in each restock window.

candidates.rule: Reply to non-food “wanted” posts that the goods will be ready at the next restock window, and use the honest estimate that windows occur about every 20 minutes rather than promising five-minute preparation.
candidates.quote: 다음 입고 창(약 20분마다)
candidates.harness: Use the next-window estimate in replies and do not promise five-minute preparation.

candidates.rule: The initial strategy prioritizes fast reputation and early transactions by building the impression that the shop sells needed products at good quality.
candidates.quote: 빠른 명성과 초기 거래
candidates.harness: Prioritize early sales and reputation through good-quality goods that meet demand.

candidates.rule: Storage costs about 25,000 won per day when inventory is worth 2.5 million won; the failure rate is undisclosed, and one warranty refund can cost as much as the sale price.
candidates.quote: 보관비(재고 250만이면 하루 약 2.5만), 보증 환불(고장률 비공개, 고장 한 건이 판매가만큼 손해)
candidates.harness: Account for storage and warranty-refund losses, and treat the failure rate as unknown.

candidates.rule: Storage costs and warranty refunds count in total losses, and a 500,000-won rollback threshold is monitored.
candidates.quote: 둘 다 `losses.total`에 들어가 되돌림 조건(50만)이 지켜본다
candidates.harness: Track both loss types toward the rollback threshold and alert or roll back when it is reached.

candidates.rule: Buyer score is 0.5 times surplus, plus 0.3 times votes received on buyer posts, plus 0.1 times trade count, plus 0.1 times buyer-authored post count; hidden posts do not count.
candidates.quote: 0.5 잉여 + 0.3 buyer 글이 받은 표 + 0.1 거래 수 + 0.1 buyer로 쓴 글 수 (숨겨진 글 제외)
candidates.harness: Calculate buyer score with these weights and exclude hidden posts.

candidates.rule: Each buyer has favorite categories, so buyer-specific category preferences and the categories wanted by the largest number of buyers are relevant to seller restocking, forum activity, and market analysis.
candidates.quote: buyer마다 즐겨 찾는 카테고리가 있다
candidates.harness: Use buyer-category preferences and aggregate demand when informing restock, forum, and strategy decisions.

candidates.rule: Whether the buyer should post a “wanted” message first to attract shop inventory remains undecided.
candidates.quote: 우리 buyer가 게시판에 "구합니다" 글을 먼저 쓸지
candidates.harness: Keep buyer-initiated wanted posts as an open strategy decision; do not assume they are required.

candidates.rule: Deliver a briefing every two hours; the proposed delivery is a brief file, a one-line pending item when a decision is needed, and a separate urgent alert for emergencies.
candidates.quote: 주기는 2시간 [결정]. **초안:** 파일
candidates.harness: Schedule briefings every two hours and use the proposed pending and urgent alert channels if approved.

candidates.rule: The timing and policy for committing source data and judgment records are unresolved; the draft commits briefings, decisions, and summaries each briefing, but keeps raw events, profiles, and some opponent messages out of commits and aggregates them only at submission.
candidates.quote: 원본과 판단 기록을 언제 커밋할지 (공개 포크). **초안:**
candidates.harness: Treat the commit policy as unresolved and do not commit raw records unless the user decides otherwise.

candidates.rule: The v1 approval and installation state and experimental baselines are the starting point; entry timing is determined in stage 6.
candidates.quote: 결정 (11/3): v1 승인·설치, 실험 기준값은 출발점. 입장 시점은 6단계에서
candidates.harness: Start from the approved and installed v1 and its baseline values; follow stage 6 for entry timing.

candidates.rule: Delegation boundaries are still a draft: the strategy agent may report after directly setting execution context, non-avoidance counterpart stances, and shop-card examples; the user retains priorities, stage changes, limits, experiments, description, avoidance and its removal, and bankruptcy decisions.
candidates.quote: 위임 범위. **초안:** 전략 에이전트가 직접(사후 보고)
candidates.harness: Do not treat the draft delegation as final; leave user-reserved decisions to the user pending confirmation.

candidates.rule: The audit model and cadence remain provisional: the draft uses a different-company OpenRouter model once per briefing, tests it once or twice on the first entry day, and then decides based on quality.
candidates.quote: 감사 에이전트의 모델(다른 회사, OpenRouter)과 주기. **초안:** 브리핑마다 한 번
candidates.harness: Keep the audit-model choice provisional and evaluate quality before fixing the model and cadence.

candidates.rule: Do not use a staged entry; build in the stated chapter order, and the user manages the schedule.
candidates.quote: 단계적 입장은 하지 않는다 [결정]. 9장 순서대로 만든다. 시간은 사용자가 관리한다
candidates.harness: Build in chapter order without staged entry and do not set the user's schedule.

candidates.rule: Put information needed in almost every situation into the default context, compare L1 latency with Claude Code’s tool loop, and use about three seconds for one Haiku call as the baseline measurement.
candidates.quote: 기본 상황에 거의 늘 필요한 것을 미리 넣는다. Claude Code 자체 툴 루프와 비교 측정
candidates.harness: Preload common context and measure L1 latency against the stated comparison and baseline.

candidates.rule: One Haiku call took about three seconds in the baseline measurement.
candidates.quote: 기준 측정: haiku 한 번 약 3초
candidates.harness: Use approximately three seconds per Haiku call as the recorded baseline, not as a guaranteed latency.

candidates.rule: Measure Claude Code usage limits on the first day, reduce usage in the stated order, and provide OpenRouter overflow for L1.
candidates.quote: 첫날 측정, 단계적으로 내리는 순서 (7장). L1은 OpenRouter로 넘침 대비
candidates.harness: Track first-day usage, follow the reduction order, and use OpenRouter as L1 overflow.

candidates.rule: Poll the ledger, shop API, Round 3 API, forum, and demand every five minutes after Round 3 opens; verify available fields and make tools rely only on local records when fields are absent.
candidates.quote: Round 3가 열리면 ledger·`/api/shops`·`/api/board?round=3`·게시판·수요를 자동으로 저장하는 감시를 걸었다(5분 간격)
candidates.harness: Start five-minute monitoring when Round 3 opens, validate fields, and fall back to local records for missing data.

candidates.rule: At 14:24 on November 3, 2026, Round 2 was still open, so Round 3 monitoring had not yet observed Round 3 data.
candidates.quote: 열리면 필드를 확인하고
candidates.harness: Treat the recorded market state as Round 2 at the stated time, not as evidence that Round 3 had opened.

candidates.rule: Run two separate runtimes as scheduled tasks and restart each after failure; keep claim codes and keys in environment variables, and have the user perform task registration.
candidates.quote: 두 런타임(2.2)으로 나누고 각각 작업 스케줄러 항목으로 등록한다
candidates.harness: Separate the runtimes, configure restart-on-failure, keep secrets in environment variables, and leave registration to the user.

candidates.rule: Give each source file one writer and replace state JSON atomically to prevent concurrent processes from corrupting shared state.
candidates.quote: 상태 JSON은 원자적 교체, 파일마다 주인 하나
candidates.harness: Enforce one writer per file and atomic replacement for state JSON.

candidates.rule: Set delegation scope and stance types in the first briefing; between 01:00 and 08:00, provide status reports only.
candidates.quote: 첫 브리핑에서 위임 범위와 자세 종류를 같이 정함, 밤(01~08시)에는 상태 보고만
candidates.harness: Resolve delegation and stance types in the first briefing and suppress non-status activity during night mode.

candidates.rule: The user installs a TeX distribution or tectonic, and the operator should run a test build before the deadline week.
candidates.quote: 사용자가 TeX 배포판(MiKTeX 등)이나 tectonic을 설치한다. 마감 주 전에 한 번 빌드해 본다
candidates.harness: Do not download or install TeX; request user installation and verify a build before deadline week.

candidates.rule: The user must rotate the exposed OpenRouter key and set a credit limit; keys belong only in environment variables.
candidates.quote: 키 교체와 크레딧 한도 설정. 키는 환경변수에만
candidates.harness: Require key rotation and a credit cap, and never store the key outside environment variables.

candidates.rule: A strategic rating that differs from its baseline requires a reason; each briefing reports the count and reasons for such ratings, and the auditor evaluates them.
candidates.quote: 기준값과 다르면 `why` 필수
candidates.harness: Require a reason for every non-baseline rating and report deviations for audit at each briefing.

candidates.rule: The user turned off the week-7 kit, seller, and tunnel on November 3, 2026, after Round 2 ended.
candidates.quote: 7주차 키트(v3 코드)와 seller, 터널을 껐다 (사용자 11/3). Round 2는 끝났다.
candidates.harness: Do not restart the retired Round 2 kit, seller, or tunnel.

candidates.rule: Do not add the considered features—such as reflection, probabilistic reputation, exploration calculations, a strategy ledger, concession curves, memory scoring, blind audits, or record-based testing—at this stage.
candidates.quote: 지금은 빼기로 했다 (사용자 결정)
candidates.harness: Keep the listed deferred features out unless the user later approves them.
